rows.definition: The locked PROVENANCE rung on a routed-expert cache receipt (internal/model/expert_cache_receipt.go): the string constant marking a measurement captured from a synthetic or replayed trace, so a simulated run can never masquerade as a hardware one. It is the sibling of ExpertCacheMeasurementHardware.
rows.distinction: Names the PROVENANCE of a receipt (simulated vs hardware), not the receipt shape (ExpertCacheReceipt) and not the residency plan or tier it measures. A receipt that flips this field to ExpertCacheMeasurementHardware without a physical capture is the exact false-green this rung exists to refuse.

rows.definition: internal/model/moe_bandwidth_partition.go MoEMissCandidate: one ACTIVATED routed expert that missed the device ring, carrying its ExpertID and a Recency score. It is the unit the MoE bandwidth-partition solver partitions between the PCIe stream and the host CPU.
rows.distinction: A single miss CANDIDATE (one expert, its recency) fed to the partition solver - not the solved split (MoEPartitionSplit), not the bandwidth profile (MoEBandwidthProfile), and not a warm-plan selection. It is the solver's input element, not its result.
